prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph shot on 35 mm colour-negative film at night in steady rain, real and grainy, never glossy or computer-generated. Rain streaks on the glass, the near tarmac smeared by motion, slight halation. No readable text, plates or logos anywhere except the poster. Thanks.
